scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:md && npm run lint:yaml

comments.linters: This is a documentation-first repository. Linter dependencies beyond ESLint are installed system-wide and configured via dotfiles (.markdownlintrc.json, .yamllint, .pylintrc). TypeScript support (eslint-config-prettier, @typescript-eslint/*) is not needed as this repo contains no TypeScript code.
